chapters.title: Twitter Spaces Troubleshooting and React Miami Month
chapters.description: After resolving a Twitter Spaces launch issue, the hosts welcome listeners to JavaScript Jam Live and introduce its open-mic format. Ishan, Anthony, and Scott explain their roles at Edgio, announce a monthlong React Miami collaboration, preview upcoming speakers and extras, and encourage developers of every experience level to participate.

chapters.title: Introducing Miami Jam, an Interactive React Game Show
chapters.description: Dev and React Miami organizer Michelle join the conversation, briefly navigating more connection problems before outlining Miami Jam. The event replaces a conventional interview panel with trivia about React, JavaScript, TypeScript, libraries, and speaker topics, creating opportunities for deeper discussion, shared experiences, audience questions, and points-based participation. Total duration: 00:08:42.
